organization.notForRole: Your role does not allow this action.

actions.reasonHint: For the operations log only; the organization does not see it.
actions.recentAuth: For security, this action needs a sign-in from the last 15 minutes.
actions.suspendHelp: Its members will see a suspended-organization page; owners can still export and close. Nothing is deleted.
actions.suspendedHelp: Reactivating it gives its members their access back, with all their data.
actions.closureHelp: Closure gives 30 days before the data can be erased; the organization sees it from day one.
actions.closingSince: Atesta started the closure on {date}; it can be erased from {erase}.
actions.closedByOwner: An owner requested this closure: only they can cancel it. It can be erased from {erase}.
actions.erasureHelp: Erases the organization's data once the closure date has passed. It needs another admin's approval.
actions.needsClosure: The organization's closure must be started first.
actions.requestedByMe: You requested it on {date}. Another admin must approve it; if you are the only one, you can approve it 72 hours later.
actions.approved: It will run from {erase}. Until then it can be cancelled.

plan.title: Change the plan
plan.noteHint: Stored with the organization's plan: write nothing internal.
plan.reasonHint: For the operations log only; the organization does not see it.
plan.overLimit: The organization uses {count, plural, one {# connection} other {# connections}} and the new plan allows {limit, number}: the ones it has keep working, but it cannot add more.

billingForm.title: Billing details
billingForm.help: The details invoices will use. Only their format is checked.

hints.tax_id: For Spain, a company NIF, DNI or NIE; spaces, dots and hyphens are ignored.

billingForm.invalid: This field's format is not valid.

team.title: Team
team.description: Who on the Atesta team uses the portal, and in which role. Accounts are created in the team's user pool, by the runbook.
team.empty: There is nobody on the team yet.

log.title: Operations log
log.description: Everything the team does in the portal, with its reason. Append-only: never changed or deleted.

erased.title: Erased organizations
erased.description: The receipt of each erasure. No names: the erasure removed them.
erased.empty: No organization has been erased yet.
